tabs.html:
Cisco Nexus N3K-3064PQ-10GX – High-Performance 48-Port 10G SFP+ Switch

Enhance Your Network with the Cisco Nexus 3064-X Switch


The Cisco Nexus N3K-3064PQ-10GX is a high-performance, low-latency, and scalable 10G switch designed for data centers, enterprise networks, and cloud environments. With 48 x 10G SFP+ and 4 x 40G QSFP+ ports, this ultra-fast Layer 2 and Layer 3 switch ensures seamless connectivity, high-density aggregation, and energy-efficient operation.


Powered by the industry-leading Cisco NX-OS Software, the Nexus 3064-X delivers advanced features, enhanced scalability, and superior reliability. Its 1RU compact design makes it an ideal choice for top-of-rack (ToR) deployments, ensuring cost-effective and high-speed data transmission.

Key Features 

  • High-Speed Connectivity – 48 x 10G SFP+ ports and 4 x 40G QSFP+ uplinks for high-bandwidth applications.
  • Low Latency & High Performance – Optimized for ultra-fast data transmission & low network congestion.
  • Line-Rate Layer 2 & Layer 3 Switching – Supports advanced routing, security, and QoS features.
  • Enterprise-Grade NX-OS Software – Ensures network stability, automation, and programmability.
  • Compact & Energy-Efficient – 1RU rack-mountable design with low power consumption.
  • Scalable & Future-Ready – Perfect for growing network demands & cloud-based infrastructures.
  • Seamless Data Center Integration – Ideal for high-density, high-speed networking solutions.


Technical Specifications

Port Configuration & Performance

Network Ports:

  • 48 x 10G SFP+ – High-speed optical fiber connectivity
  • 4 x 40G QSFP+ uplinks – Enhanced scalability for high-traffic networks


Switching Capabilities:

  • Line-Rate Layer 2 and Layer 3 Switching – Optimal for enterprise and cloud environments.
  • Low-Latency Design – Ideal for high-performance computing & financial networks.
  • Advanced Traffic Management – Supports VLANs, QoS, and robust security protocols.


Rack Mountable: 1U form factor – Space-saving design for data centers.


Software & Network Management

  • NX-OS Software – Industry-leading operating system for network stability & automation.
  • Advanced Routing Protocols – Supports BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, and more.
  • Programmability & Automation – REST APIs, Python scripting, and Cisco DevNet support.


Power & Cooling

Energy-Efficient Design:

  • Optimized for Low Power Consumption – Reduces operating costs & environmental impact.
  • Efficient Cooling System – Designed for high-performance workloads.


Ideal Applications

  • Data Centers – High-speed connectivity for cloud computing & virtualization.
  • Enterprise Networks – Scalable solutions for growing business infrastructure.
  • High-Frequency Trading – Low-latency performance for financial networks.
  • Cloud Service Providers – Ensures seamless integration & bandwidth efficiency.
  • Top-of-Rack Deployments – High-density Layer 2 and Layer 3 aggregation.


Why Choose the Cisco Nexus N3K-3064PQ-10GX?

  • Unmatched Performance – High-speed, low-latency 10G and 40G connectivity.
  • Scalable & Future-Proof – Designed for growing networks & high-demand applications.
  • Reliable & Secure – Enterprise-grade Cisco NX-OS software for seamless operations.
  • Energy-Efficient & Compact – 1U rack-mountable design with power-efficient operation.
  • Seamless Integration – Compatible with existing network infrastructure.
